title: Duplicated unix_secs_to_rfc3339 across three modules
description: Three independent implementations of unix_secs_to_rfc3339: contact.rs (lines 172–227, loop-based), chat.rs (lines 196–247, identical loop logic), and message.rs (lines 38–64, Howard Hinnant algorithm). Code duplication at this scale creates maintenance risk: if a bug is found, all three must be updated. The message.rs implementation is superior (well-vetted algorithm). Recommendation: extract a shared private helper in lib.rs or migrate all three to use the Hinnant algorithm. No functional issue today, but violates DRY and creates future risk.
